description:
WHAT YOU GET

→ See your real $/hour before you accept a trip
→ Track business miles for tax deductions
→ Track up to $725 in potential deductions per 1,000 business miles
→ Scan receipts — snap, save, deduct
→ See earnings, miles, hours, and expenses in one dashboard
→ Export IRS-ready mileage and tax reports

— — —

WHY DRIVERS SWITCH TO GIGREAL

Most mileage trackers only show what already happened.

GigReal helps you understand what you actually keep, which trips are worth your time, and how your miles, expenses, and earnings affect your real take-home pay.

Built by drivers, for drivers. No spreadsheets. No guessing.

Works great for rideshare, delivery, and gig drivers using platforms like Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Instacart, Grubhub, and more.

— — —

Subscription Required: Some features (including Mileage Tracking, Earnings Management, Expense Tracking, etc.) are available with an in-app subscription. A monthly or yearly plan is required after the free trial.
releaseNotes:
Connected Gig Accounts
Link supported gig apps and keep recent earnings updated automatically in one place.

Daily & Weekly Recaps
Get clear, complete summaries after your connected accounts finish updating.

Clearer Expenses & Reports
Explore a redesigned monthly expense report, improved category visuals, and more consistent totals.

Improved Trip Identifier
Smarter setup, clearer feedback, and better tools for reviewing missed offers.

Help & Support
A new support center keeps conversations, responses, resources, and service updates together.

As always, we’ve made additional reliability, localization, and accessibility improvements throughout GigReal.
